task: Make Kyverno key attestors skip Rekor tlog and SCT so air-gapped static-key image verification does not need Rekor reachability (PR #389 review MEDIUM finding, D-REKOR)

events.summary: Keep verify-image-signatures in Audit with required:false and unchanged keys; CI keeps uploading to public Rekor; only add ignoreTlog/ignoreSCT to the two key attestors. scripts/airgap/10-verify-image-signatures.sh does not invoke cosign verify, so it is untouched.
Before the change the key attestors had no rekor/ctlog block, so Kyverno would look up the public Rekor log during verification, which an air-gapped cluster cannot reach once the policy is Enforce.

Added rekor.ignoreTlog: true and ctlog.ignoreSCT: true to the signature and CycloneDX attestation attestors (fields confirmed in Kyverno v1.18.1 image_verification_types.go), extended R74 to require them, added R75d mutation test, documented D-REKOR in the policy YAML comment and both docs.
Static regression suite passes including R74 and the new R75d (flipping ignoreTlog to false is rejected).
make validate parsed the edited kyverno-policies.yaml.
Static guards and docs done; behavior of Kyverno against a live air-gapped cluster and a real signed image is not verified.
Static guards verified; policy stays Audit, no live cluster mutation.
